notes.title: Update Notice :)
notes.content:
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

[b]Added 18 Steam Achievements! [/b]
  - 9 Kiss Album Contents
  - 9 Badge Contents

[b]Updated UI[/b]
 - We made it more easy to play, more easy to understand :)

[b]Added new BGM[/b]
  JoshWoodward - "LittleTomcat" in joshwoodward.com

notes.title: Patch(v1.1) : User Experience Upgrade
notes.content:
- Menu UI was changed, more intuitive than before. So you do not have to learn how to use controller in detail. 

- Vive Controller SDK was changed to make you feel better when you select the buttons in VR Play.
